item.description:

Tropical Weather Outlook
NWS National Hurricane Center Miami FL
800 PM EDT Fri Oct 2 2026

For the North Atlantic...Caribbean Sea and the Gulf of America:

Subtropical West-Central Atlantic (Remnants of Fay):
Showers and thunderstorms associated with the remnants of former
Tropical Storm Fay located several hundred miles southeast of
Bermuda have become less organized since yesterday. No further
development is expected while it moves north-northwestward at 5 to
10 mph to the east of Bermuda.
* Formation chance through 48 hours...low...near 0 percent.
* Formation chance through 7 days...low...near 0 percent.

$$
Forecaster Blake
